author: Bobby Grayson
description: Leanactors/Examples/Ttl.lean now imports Leanactors.Explore, defines envMsgs : Pid -> List Msg (0 => [put 0, put 1], 1 => [ask]) and explore b sg s depth env := exploreWith b sg checkInv envMsgs s depth env; local livePids and the partial explore are deleted. README/NOTES lines quoting 16,723 for Ttl need 16,093; Explore.lean's docstring 'Ttl.lean and Lock.lean keep local explorers' should read 'Lock.lean keeps a local explorer'.
title: Ttl on Sys.exploreWith: 16723 -> 16093 configurations; the 630 dropped are env deliveries to the dead cache (pid 0), which Config.deliver makes a no-op and the old local explorer still counted as configurations. Verified: the old explorer restricted to live pids gives exactly 16093; the mutant witness (29, timer 0/run 0/timer 0/run 0/env put 0 -> 0/run 0) is byte-identical. No new reachable state; the count could only be kept identical by adding a dead-pid knob to Explore.lean, which was not done.
